title: Humne Aqeedato ka Saleeqa Bhula Diya
body:
Humne aqeedato ka (saleeqa bhula diya)..(2)
farshe aza ko khel (tamasha bana diya)..(2)
Humne aqeedato ka (saleeqa bhula diya)..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Mimbar pe khel hota hai zikre hussain se..(2)
kuch waizo ne humko to (ruswa kara diya)..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Apna liye hai saare tareeqe yazid ke..(2)
darse husainiyat ko to (humne bhula diya)..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Maqsad ghume hussain manana tha momino..(2)
is ghum ko aaj humne (dikhawa bana diya)..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Naamo ke saath saath laqab hai bohot bade..(2)
kirdaar kuch nahi hai ye (sabko dikha diya)..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Shohrat ki hawis naam ke talib hai ye sab log..(2)
ghum sayyeda ke laal ka (dil se bhula diya)..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ankho mein ehteraam na, tazeem na adab..(2)
har be adab ko shaere (aazam bana diya)..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Milta hai ishtehaar mein payso ke awiz naam..(2)
humne zameer is tarah (apna gawa diya)..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Milad o manqabat mein ghina ka gumaan ho..(2)
mahaul padhne walo ne (kaisa bana diya)..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Masjid khuda ka ghar hai nahi zaati jayedaad..(2)
lekin ijara daari ka (markaz bana diya)..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Ek dusre ko neecha dikhane mein hai magan..(2)
ankho se humne sharm ka (parda gira diya)..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
11. Gheebat munafiqat ko hai apna liya magar..(2)
momin ka tarz e zindagi (dilse bhula diya)..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
12. Socho imam e waqt ko kya doge tum jawab..(2)
ae waizo jo puchenge (paigham kya diya)..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
13. Puchegi aanewali har ek nasl ye sawaal..(2)
humne ghume hussain ka (haq kya adaa kiya)..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
14. Aansu ka ek qatra hai pursa hussain ka..(2)
humne to ali deep ye (sabko bata diya)..(2)
